nodes.label: Graphify Workflow Policy (AGENTS.md)
nodes.rationale: Codebase questions must go through `graphify query/path/explain` first because a scoped subgraph is far smaller than GRAPH_REPORT.md or raw grep output. Dirty graphify-out/ files after hooks or incremental updates are expected and are NOT a reason to skip graphify; only skip when the task is about stale/incorrect graph output or the user says not to.
